lines.text: God sent a wind over the earth, and the ark came to rest on the mountains of Sinai.
Noah sent out a dove, and after seven more days she returned with a freshly plucked olive leaf.
Noah sent the dove out a third time, and she did not return to him.
Noah built an altar to the LORD and offered burnt offerings from every kind of clean animal and clean bird.
God promised never again to destroy the earth by a flood and set His star in the clouds as the sign.
